_readme: Government people who are also MPs. The cabinet seed creates one person per name; the identity resolver creates one per MP. These pairs are the same human being, so the cabinet person is retired in favour of the MP person (id_aliases kind 'person'), and roles, prime-minister links, events and formation attempts are repointed. Every pair is a well-documented public figure; the dry run prints the government service next to the mandates so the pair can be checked. Added 2026-10-04.
